model: VX4 Energy Management Thermostats with BACnet Integration
applies_to: Verdant (Copeland) VX4 energy management thermostats on a 900 MHz mesh network, integrated through the Verdant Online Connection Kit.
summary: Verdant VX4 thermostats talk to each other over a proprietary 900 MHz mesh, and one Online Connection Kit puts the whole network on the building's BACnet network. Every room gets the same 15 objects; the object instance is a fixed base number per object plus the room number. The sheet does not name BACnet IP or MS/TP; its network drawing shows the kit on the building automation LAN.
notes: Instances shown are the printed base values. The sheet gives each room's instance as base + hex2dec(room number): read the room number as a hexadecimal number, convert it to decimal and add it to the base. For example, room 101 is 0x101 = 257, so its Room Temperature is AV 500257. The sheet gives no worked example, so confirm against a discovered device.
Cool Setpoint and Heat Setpoint are read-only; the writable setpoint is Guest Setpoint (60-90 °F).
Fan Speed uses different codes for reading and writing (see states).
Thermostat Status combined with System Mode gives the heating/cooling state; values 2 and 3 mean the room is in setback (unoccupied).
The spec sheet does not state the BACnet transport; the network drawing places the Online Connection Kit on the building automation LAN.

source.title: VX4 Energy Management Thermostats with BACnet Integration (spec sheet)

integration.summary: The sheet lists 15 objects per room, reached through the Online Connection Kit; work out each room's instances from the base numbers plus the room number read as hex. Write System Mode, Fan Speed and Guest Setpoint per room; read Room Temperature, Occupancy State, Thermostat Status and the setpoints. Watch Gateway Online Status for loss of the thermostat network.

minimum_points.name: Fan Speed
minimum_points.why: Fan command; write codes differ from read codes

setup: One Online Connection Kit links the 900 MHz thermostat mesh to the BACnet network; no Wi-Fi is needed at the rooms.
Object instance = printed base + room number read as hex and converted to decimal (room 101 -> 257, so Room Temperature is AV 500257).
gotchas: Fan Speed reads back 0-3 but must be written with 0, 1, 85, 170 or 254.
Cool Setpoint and Heat Setpoint are read-only; use Guest Setpoint to change the room setpoint.
Min/Max Setpoint Limit and Heat EQP Lockout are configuration values; don't write them cyclically.
